summary: @or-sdk/data-hub preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods +x, and invokes it against a package-local file `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)`). The Node process itself never loads `math_init.js`, and neither the CJS nor ESM `main` entry references it, so the file only ever executes under the freshly fetched alien runtime. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with a shuffled string-array decoder (`WV8StW` rotating `n7gIxM`) and `_0xNNNN`-renamed identifiers; its name is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a DataHub HTTP client SDK). The combination of a lifecycle-triggered alternate-runtime fetch, execution of an obfuscated sibling bundle unreachable from the Node entry points, and a bundle whose name and shape are unrelated to the SDK's declared purpose is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing the package auto-runs opaque code under a runtime that bypasses Node-level inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
